item.hado.marker_remote.tip: Right-click without sneaking: open the marker screen. Sneak + right-click: open the tuner.
item.hado.marker_beacon.tip: Right-click: plant a beacon marker where you look; it pulses and remembers the point.
item.hado.swift_edge.tip: Right-click: a quick forward cut with a slashed-back ring.
item.hado.recurve_map.tip: Right-click: draw a tether to the struck point and ring a return.
item.hado.drift_compass.tip: Right-click: tune in nearby threats and ring when something drifts in.
item.hado.loom_thread.tip: Right-click: leave a spun stitch; use it twice to place, again to clear the marker.
item.hado.chime_bell.tip: Right-click: clear the nearest threat in a clean ring and clear the marker.
item.hado.glimmer_lantern.tip: Right-click: glow a halo toward the point you look at.
item.hado.homing_kite.tip: Right-click: fly a tethered kite toward the last marker, or taunt the air if none is set.
item.hado.anchor_stamp.tip: Right-click: stamp the current spot as a marker anchor and thud it down.
item.hado.counter_scribe.tip: Right-click: read the last event note and write a small tracked annotation into the marker.
item.hado.mirror_lens.tip: Right-click: flip the last event note in the current marker and play a lens glint.
item.hado.marker_pen.tip: Right-click: draw a marker-style FX line along the looked-at path.
screen.hado.marker.title: Marker Screen
screen.hado.marker.description: One active marker per player session. Set a target, clear it, or restore to it. Restore is a bounded teleport and a last-event cue — it is not a world rollback.
